Clarifies that a custom mode does not change NODE_ENV / import.meta.env.PROD
evals.expected_output: Explanation that .env files load after config resolution (use loadEnv in the config), and that builds default to production mode so 'vite build --mode staging' is needed to load .env.staging, with the mode vs NODE_ENV distinction.
